Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Barbados Women players make their way out to the middle. Muneeba Ali and Iram Javed are the openers for Pakistan Women. Shamilia Connell to start with the ball. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, Pakistan Women have a chaseable score in front of them. However, they have struggled while chasing in the recent past and they need a good start with the bat to chase this down. Barbados Women do have quality bowlers in their line-up and it can well turn out to be a fascinating chase. Stay tuned for the run-chase!

Pakistan bowlers were quite tight in their lines and length throughout the innings. Diana Baig swung the ball beautifully with the new ball and got a bit wicket of Dottin. Spinners did not give away many runs in the middle overs and in the end, Fatima Sana took two wickets but she was the only bowler who was a bit expensive on the day.

Barbados Women lost an early wicket of big-hitting Deandra Dottin. Kycia Knight then joined Hayley Matthews in the middle and both the batters decided to take a conservative route. They did not take many risks in the middle overs and had plenty of wickets in hand coming into the death overs and Hayley Matthews after scoring a fine fifty departed in the 18th over. Kycia Knight also got to her fifty and batted till the end to take her team to a competitive total here.

This has been a decent batting effort from Barbados Women. However, it’s a score that Pakistan can chase down here if their batters apply themselves in the middle. Both teams will fancy their chances and we surely have an interesting chase on the cards.

OUT! THE BATTER IS SHORT! Outside off, Aaliyah Alleyne swings but misses. They go for a run. The keeper throws it to the bowler who hits the stumps at the other end. Barbados Women WOMEN END WITH 144!
Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point for one.
Two more! A full toss outside off, this is hit towards deep cover for two.
WIDE! This is well wide outside off. Knight looks toi cut but misses.
FOUR! Paddle scoop and done brilliantly! On middle, this is paddle scooped over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
TWO MORE! Outside off, this is lofted over covers for two.
Aaliyah Alleyne is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the perfect start to the last over for Pakistan! A slower one, on middle, Knight looks to go down the ground but does not time it that well. She holes out to the fielder at long on.
Commentary.Howout: c Aliya Riaz b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, this is carved towards point for one.
A single now! Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
A yorker outside off, Knight looks to jam it out but misses.
FOUR! Slammed down the ground! Full and on middle, this is hit over the bowler's head for another boundary! This is a superb innings by Knight.
On middle, this is played down to long on for one.
Very full and outside off, Knight looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! CHEEKY! Second boundary in the over! This is on off, Knight moves across and plays thge paddle scoop down to the fine leg fence.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for another single.
FOUR! That is a poor ball! On the pads, Knight plays it nice and fine and this one races away ot the fence. Not the ball you want to bowl to a new batter.
Fuller and on off, Knight pushes it to mid off.
Two! Good running! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two!

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch that is! Wow and a huge wicket for Pakistan and a timely one! Hayley Matthews could have taken her sides' score to 150 but she falls with three overs to go. This is full and on middle, Hayley Matthews looks to be cheeky, she tries to play the reverse paddle scoop, it goes off the face but since it is too full, she does not get elevation. The keeper reacts well and takes it to her right. Kyshona Knight is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Muneeba Ali b Fatima Sana

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on middle. Hayley Matthews drives it to long on for a single.
A flatter one on off. Hayley Matthews blocks it out.
On middle. Knight pushes it towards the off side for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is tossed up, on off. Knight drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.
On off, pushed to covers for a single.
This is fuller and outside off. Knight drives it through extra-cover and comes back for three runs.
On the shorter side, on off. Knight punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Hayley Matthews pushes it to extra-cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Knight drives it to covers for a single.
Pushed quicker on off. Knight blcoks it out.
On middle and the batter works it to mid-wicket for a single.
On off and fuller. Hayley Matthews pushes it to covers and takes two.
Goes much fuller, on middle. Hayley Matthews drives it to long on for a single. 100 up for Barbados Women!
Turning into middle. Hayley Matthews works it towards the leg side.
Touch shorter and flatter on off. Hayley Matthews goes back and punches it to covers.
SIX! Hayley Matthews opens her arms finally and gets the first maximum of the game! Tossed up on off. Hayley Matthews gets under it and tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
A flatter delivery on off. Knight goes back and defends it square off the wicket towards the off side for a single.
Bit shorter in length, on off. Hayley Matthews goes deep in her crease and works it to long on for a single.
Quicker and on the shorter side, outside off. Knight looks to cut it but misses.
Tossed up, on off. Hayley Matthews drives it to long off for a single.
TWO WIDES! Drifted down the leg side. Knight looks to sweep it but misses. The ball hits the keeper's pads and deflects towards the short fine leg region. A bye taken.
Pulls her length back, on middle. Hayley Matthews goes back and works it wide of long on for a single.
Knight misses out there! A low full toss on off. Knight heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Hayley Matthews drives it to deep extra-cover for a single.
A very full delivery on off. Hayley Matthews digs it out to backward point.
Another single as Hayley Matthews knocks this full delivery to long off.
Tossed up on middle. Knight drives it to long on for a single.
Slower through the air again, on off. Knight pushes it towards the off side.
FOUR! Barbados Women getting a move on now! This is floated up on off. Knight picks it up and hits it wide of long on. The ball goes off the bounce into the fence.
Tossed up, on off. Knight drives it to covers.
FOUR! Nice placement! This is fuller around leg. Knight sweeps it through the backward square leg region and beats the diving fielder in the deep.
Tossed up, on off. Knight drives it to covers and takes a single.
WIDE! This is fuller and down the leg side. Knight looks to paddle it but misses.
Goes fuller on off. Knight drives it to mid off.
This is quite short again, outside off. Hayley Matthews cuts but the point fielder stops it. Another single added to the total.
Shorter in length and around off. Knight slams it to mid on. However, the fielder makes a good stop and it is just a single.
Pushed quicker on off. Hayley Matthews pushes it to covers for a single.
Tossed up on off. Knight slogs it aerially and the ball falls short of long on. A single taken.
WIDE! Omaima Sohail sees Knight advancing and bowls it way down the leg side. Knight fails to connect her shot but gets her bat back in the crease before th keeper whips the bails off.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A half-tracker on leg. Hayley Matthews goes deep in her crease and pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
There seems to be some problem with one bail. The umpire has called for a new bail now as one bail is not lighting up.
Shorter in length and outside off. Hayley Matthews cuts it to left of sweeper cover and comes back for the second run.
A flatter one on middle. Hayley Matthews blocks it out.
Pitched up on middle. Knight heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Hayley Matthews drives it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Hayley Matthews clips it to short fine leg.
Two dots in a row! Knight steps out and hammers it back straight back at the bowler.
Yet another dot! Knight needs to step on the gas here! On off, this is guided to point.
Dealing in singles at the moment! Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
WIDE! This one is well wide outside off, left alone.
That was really slow and on the pads, Matthews looks to sweep but misses, it hits the pad and goes down to fine leg for one.
Another dot! Dots will only build pressure! Shorter and outside off, Hayley looks to cut but is beaten.
Knight is happy to take singles at the moment! On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Another dot to end! On off, on the shorter side, Hayley looks to cut but chops it towards point. Another tidy over. Pressure building on Barbados Women now.
Just another single! Dealing in singles at the moment! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Just the one! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Hayley Matthews steps out but yorks herself, she jams it out to point.
That is brilliant running! Tossed up around off, this is hit through covers for two.
Shorter and on off, this is cut but to point.
Tuba Hassan is into the attack now.
A single to end! A tidy over from Dar! On middle, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A fuller delivery on middle. Knight works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, this is jammed out to covers.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.

NOT OUT! Hayley Matthews' dive saves her! This is tossed up on the pads, it is defended. Hayley is off for a run but is sent back. The keeper gets to the ball and hits the stumps at the bowler's end, it is taken upstairs, replays show that Hayley is in.
Is this a run out? Hayley Matthews has put in a dive at the bowler's end and that has helped her get back to the crease.
A single to end another good over for Barbados Women! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Another single! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
FOIUR! That is the wrong line and Hayley Matthews puts it away. Short and on the body, this is pulled behind square on the leg side. It races away to the fence.
Tip and run! On off, Kycia Knight pushes it towards cover and takes one.
Kycia Knight seems to be in some pain and the physio comes out and she gets some treatment on her right hand. Looks fine now and we are ready to resume.
FOUR! Picked it up brilliantly! Short and on middle, Kycia Knight rocks back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder and it goes into the fence.
Single to end the over! Slower through the air, on off. Knight knocks it down to long off for a single. Barbados Women are 38/1 after the Powerplay!
A fuller one on off. Hayley Matthews drives it to long on for a single.
That turns away from Hayley Matthews! It is shorter and outside off. Hayley Matthews looks to cut it but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge of her blade.
A fuller delivery on middle. Knight works it to square leg for a single.
This was close! Shorter length, outside off. Hayley Matthews looks to pull it but gets the inside edge. The ball brushes Muneeba Ali's gloves and goes behind her. A single taken.
Tossed up, on off. Hayley Matthews drives it back to the bowler.
Goes a tad fuller and around off. Knight drives it to covers this time.
On a length, on off. Knight defends it off the front foot.

FOUR! Luck going Barbados Women's way at the moment! A full delivery, around off. Knight makes a bit of room and looks to go over the top. However, all she manages is to get an outside edge which runs away towards the third man fence.
Goes fuller on off. Knight drives it straight to mid off.
On a length, on middle. Hayley Matthews works it towards the leg side and takes a single.
FOUR! Lovely timinig! Sana drifts on the pads. Hayley Matthews waits for it and then glances it past square leg for a boundary.
On the shorter side, on off. Knight blocks it off the back foot.

Dropped! Tossed up, on off. Hayley Matthews makes a bit of room and tries to go over covers. However, she hits it just left of  Diana Baig at covers. She gets a hand on it but fails to catch it. A single taken.
Pushed quicker on off. Hayley Matthews pushes it towards mid on.
A flatter one on middle. Hayley Matthews defends it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short and wide outside off. Hayley Matthews rocks back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs for Barbados Women! It is short and way down the leg side. Hayley Matthews looks to pull it but misses. The keeper misses it too and the ball races away towards the fence.
On the shorter side, on off. Hayley Matthews pushes it off the back foot to the right of the bowler.
A fuller delivery on off. Knight skips down the track and hits it firmly to mid off.

An appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is not interested. Pakistan Women review! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved, So Knight will continue. Coming to the ball - It is fuller and outside off. Knight tries to drive it away from her body. She misses but Pakistan players appeal as they might have heard some noise but there was not edge found out in the end.
On a length, around off. Knight dabs it towards the off side.
FOUR! First signs of aggression from Kycia Knight! On a length, around off. Knight advances down the track and hits it over mid off for a boundary. It almost travels all the way.
Keeps the length full and continues to get that away shape. It is outside off and Hayley Matthews gets an outside edge to third man as she looks to drive. A single taken.
A fullish delivery, on off. Hayley Matthews drives it to mid off.
Fuller length, on off. Knight comes well forward and defends it off the outside half of her blade towards point.
Pulls her length back, around off. Knight is happy to just push it towards covers.
Slower through the air, on off. Knight goes forward and blocks it out.
Tad shorter again, same line too and Knight punches it off the back foot to covers.
Keeps it short again, around off. Kycia Knight chops it to covers.
On the shorter side, on off. Hayley Matthews punches it to long on and gets off the mark with a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Kycia Knight blocks it from her crease. A successful first over for Pakistan.

OUT! CAUGHT! Diana Baig strikes in her first over and this is a big wicket for Pakistan Women! Baig bowls that length which is just short of full length. Dottin goes for the drive but plays it uppishly towards covers and Bismah Maroof there takes a sharp catch to her right. Kycia Knight is the next batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Bismah Maroof b Diana Baig

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Finds the edge but it runs away towards the fence! Nice shape for Baig again. It is a fullish delivery, around off. It swings away and catches the outside edge of Dottin's blade as she looks to drive it away. The ball runs away towards the third man fence.
Pulls her length back a bit, it is outside off. Dottin looks to guide it away towards the off side but misses.
FOUR! That's how she plays, Deandra Dottin is off the mark in style!  A full delivery on off. Dottin just stays still in her crease and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
WIDE! Drifts down the leg side this time. Dottin looks to flick it but misses.
Baig starts off with a fullish delivery. She gets some good outswing on this delivery. It is on off and Dottin drives but gets the outside half of her blade as the ball goes towards point.

We are all set to begin! The Pakistan Women players are in the huddle and they disperse now to take their respective positions. Hayley Matthews and Deandra Dottin are the openers for Barbados Women. Diana Baig to start with the ball for Pakistan Women. Here we go...

Barbados Women (Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Deandra Dottin, Kycia Knight (WK), Kyshona Knight, Aaliyah Alleyne, Trishan Holder, Alisa Scantlebury, Shakera Selman, Shamilia Connell, Aaliyah Williams, Shanika Bruce.
Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Muneeba Ali (WK), Iram Javed, Bismah Maroof (C), Omaima Sohail, Nida Dar, Aliya Riaz, Ayesha Naseem, Fatima Sana, Tuba Hassan, Diana Baig, Anam Amin.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Pakistan Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

For those wondering which team is Barbados representating, then let me tell you they are doing so for the Windies. They are a strong side with the likes of Deandra Dottin, Hayley Matthews and a few others. Pakistan too have a few decent players in their side and they would need their star players like Nida Dar and Bismah Maroof to come to the party. Toss and team news in a bit.
